_notes.dewford_harbour: 0x352-0x377: Emerald's harbour building at the foot of Birth Island / Navel Rock; labelled water because the harbour rooms are not built (the S.S. Tidal docks at the dock's end, Southern Island's way); 0x353-0x355 its walkable top row = the dock's end
_notes.navelrock_top: NavelRock_Top: 0x33c sky -> void (as Sky Pillar's top), the summit floor path, its walls cliff; the rock's olive lower slopes and the pillar's lower body (scenery below the summit) void too: the summit floats in the dark like Sky Pillar's top; its two stair tiles 0x204 are path (one flat summit: a level change drew a cliff band across the whole void)
